name: Vineesha Mangu
message: I will truly miss you Tanu, All the best

name: Vishwaja Biroju
message: It was really good working with you Tanu.You are colourful and you make others feel the same.continue to Art. Enjoy parties.Keep Shining.All the Best Tanu!.

name: Malladi Sirisha
message:
Dear Tanushree,

Wishing you all the very best on your new journey!

I would like to take this opportunity to thank you for training me, guiding me, and patiently helping me understand the work. I have learned so much from you, and I truly appreciate all the support you have given me.

It was a pleasure working with you. Your guidance and kindness will always be remembered. We will definitely miss you in our team!

Wishing you lots of success, happiness, and new opportunities ahead. Stay in touch and keep shining! All the very best!

name: Priti M
message:
It's hard to say goodbye to someone who has become more than just a colleague and a truly good friend. I'm going to miss having you around, our conversations, laughs and all the little moments we've shared.

Although you'll be moving to a different team, I hope you know that this isn't goodbye. Wishing you all the success, happiness and exciting opportunities in your new role. They are lucky to have you!

Keep in touch, and don't forget us!

name: Aishu
message:
It's hard to put into words how much we'll miss you. 💕 The energy, positivity, and warmth you bring to the team make such a difference every single day. ✨ Your presence has always brightened up the workplace. 😊

You are one of the sweetest and most genuine people, and it has been an absolute pleasure working alongside you. ❤️ Thank you for all the support, laughter, encouragement, and wonderful memories you've given us. 🤗🌸

While we're sad to see you go, we're also incredibly excited for this new chapter in your life. 🌟

Wishing you all the very best for your new beginning. 💐 May it be filled with growth, achievements, and endless joy. ✨🎉 Don't be a stranger, we'll truly miss you. ❤️🤗

name: Shailaja Pulimamidi
message:
We've had so many ups and downs over the years, and yes, a few fights too, but one thing that never changed was our friendship. We always knew how to keep work and friendship separate, and I think that's one of the reasons we've remained so close.

I'm really going to miss everything, the laughs, the disagreements, the "Alka" moments you used to do, and all the little things that made every day interesting. You've been a big part of my journey, The good thing is that you're not going far, and we're still in the same office. So this isn't really goodbye! Let's make sure we catch up in Orbit whenever we're free for coffee and muffins.

I'm going to miss you, babe. Wishing you all the happiness and success in this new chapter. ❤️🤗

Lots of love 💕

name: Sunny Kumar Yadav
message:
As we say goodbye, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude and appreciation for all the wonderful moments, support, and memories shared together. It has been a pleasure working with you, and your presence will surely be missed.

Wishing you all the very best for your future endeavours. May this new chapter bring you happiness, success, and exciting opportunities.

Good luck, and stay in touch!

name: Venkatesh Thaneeru
message:
Thank you so much, Tanu, for everything! ❤️

I have learned so much from you, and I really appreciate the patience you had in teaching me and helping me whenever I needed it. Your guidance, support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I will always remember everything you have taught me and the support you have given me over the years.

I truly wish you all the very best for your future. May you achieve great success and happiness in everything you do. You will definitely be missed! ❤️

name: Vineet Dasari
message:
Tanu ❤️,

TBH, when I first joined this team, I often felt a little left out and didn't really know where I belonged. But then you took me under your wing and looked after me like a literal little brother. You made me feel welcome, helped me find my place, and showed me the ropes. You taught me how things work, guided me through things I didn't know, and always did it with so much patience. I don't think you realise how much that meant to me.

And it's not just with me. That's just who you are. You're always kind, patient and approachable with everyone around you. You have this incredible ability to make even the most complicated work look like a piece of cake. You just play around with your work as if it's the easiest thing in the world, and honestly, you're so good at what you do!

To us, you're not just a talented colleague. You're the glue that holds this team together. So yes, we're definitely going to miss you, and a little part of us wishes we didn't have to say goodbye. But more than that, we're genuinely happy and excited to see you move on to bigger and better things. You deserve every bit of this new opportunity, and I have no doubt you'll absolutely rock your new role!

One thing I hope never changes is that beautiful kindness of yours. Keep being the person who makes people feel comfortable, supported and welcome. Keep that spark in you alive, and never lose that beautiful smile.

Thank you for taking me under your wing, for being so patient with me, and for making my journey in this team a little easier and a lot more meaningful.

All the very best, Tanu! We'll miss you more than you know. ❤️

P.S. Your little brother is going to miss having you around! ❤️

name: Hanee
message: You’ll be greatly missed! Go chase those dreams and shine. Best of luck Tanushree
